key_insight: Trustworthy AI-assisted formalization in scientific computing requires identifying layer-specific failure modes and supplying expert feedback to recover mathematical soundness.
engineering_relevance: The study offers guidance for using AI agents to formalize scientific computing mathematics, where computational procedures and modeling transformations complicate proof construction.
method: Study AI-assisted formalization across abstraction layers of the scientific computing software stack.
Classify failure modes and analyze the expert feedback needed at each layer.
Derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns and sound use of AI agents.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports cross-layer case studies evaluating numerical proof completion and failure causes, but provides no case counts or quantitative success rates.
watch_item: Proof completion alone should not be treated as validation that the formal statement faithfully represents the intended computation or model.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
